answer.sql:
SELECT
  effective_date,
  annual_premium,
  ROUND((annual_premium - LAG(annual_premium) OVER (ORDER BY effective_date)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(annual_premium) OVER (ORDER BY effective_date), 0), 2) AS pct_change_from_previous
FROM (
  SELECT
    pcd.Effective_Date AS effective_date,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium
  FROM policy p
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  JOIN policy_amount pa ON pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
  GROUP BY pcd.Effective_Date
) t
ORDER BY effective_date;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 5 THEN '0-5 miles'
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 10 THEN '6-10 miles'
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 15 THEN '11-15 miles'
    ELSE 'More than 15 miles'
  END AS distance_band,
  COUNT(*) AS number_of_claims,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
WHERE Nearest_Firestation_miles IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY MIN(Nearest_Firestation_miles);

SELECT
  (Year_Built // 10) * 10 AS decade,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS avg_loss_ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS num_claims
FROM fire_claim
WHERE Year_Built IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY (Year_Built // 10) * 10
ORDER BY decade ASC;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Loss_Ratio >= 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_high_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim;

SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN LOWER(Fireplace) IN ('yes', 'y', 'true', '1') THEN Loss_Ratio END)
  - AVG(CASE WHEN LOWER(Fireplace) IN ('no', 'n', 'false', '0') THEN Loss_Ratio END) AS avg_loss_ratio_difference
FROM fire_claim;

SELECT CORR(Number_of_Firefighters, Loss_Ratio) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM fire_claim;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT pa.Effective_Date, pa.Policy_Amount
  FROM policy po
  JOIN policy_amount pa ON po.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
  JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  WHERE po.Policy_Number = 31003000336
),
first_p AS (
  SELECT Effective_Date, Policy_Amount FROM p ORDER BY Effective_Date ASC LIMIT 1
),
last_p AS (
  SELECT Effective_Date, Policy_Amount FROM p ORDER BY Effective_Date DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT POWER(l.Policy_Amount * 1.0 / f.Policy_Amount, 1.0 / date_diff('year', f.Effective_Date, l.Effective_Date)) - 1 AS cagr
FROM first_p f, last_p l;

SELECT Number_of_Firefighters, AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS avg_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
GROUP BY Number_of_Firefighters
ORDER BY avg_loss_ratio ASC
LIMIT 1;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  DATE_DIFF('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Open_Date) AS days_incident_to_open,
  DATE_DIFF('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) AS days_open_to_close,
  100.0 * DATE_DIFF('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)
    / NULLIF(DATE_DIFF('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date), 0) AS pct_time_open
FROM claim c
JOIN occurrences o
  ON c.Occurrence_Identifier = o.Occurrence_Identifier;

WITH losses AS (
    SELECT SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_losses
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.Claim_Open_Date) = 2019
      AND (
          ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment)
          OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve)
      )
),
premiums AS (
    SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pcd.Effective_Date) = 2019
      AND pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Policy_Amount_Identifier FROM premium)
)
SELECT
    l.incurred_losses,
    p.total_premium,
    CAST(l.incurred_losses AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(p.total_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio_2019
FROM losses l
CROSS JOIN premiums p;

SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS total_loss,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS total_expense,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0)
         / SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END)
  END AS expense_pct_of_loss
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment) lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve) lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment) ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve) er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number, cat.Catastrophe_Name
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  ca.Claim_Identifier,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE)
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_to_reserved_ratio
FROM claim_amount ca
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment) lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment) ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve) lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve) er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier;

WITH prem AS (
  SELECT pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
         SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium p ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
cov_claims AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Identifier, Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  FROM claim_coverage
),
claim_loss AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
  FROM claim_amount ca
  WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment)
     OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve)
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT po.Policy_Number,
       pcd.Effective_Date AS coverage_start_date,
       prem.premium,
       SUM(COALESCE(cl.incurred_loss, 0)) AS incurred_loss,
       SUM(COALESCE(cl.incurred_loss, 0)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(prem.premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM policy_coverage_detail pcd
JOIN policy po
  ON po.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN cov_claims cc
  ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_loss cl
  ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem
  ON prem.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
GROUP BY po.Policy_Number, pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier, pcd.Effective_Date, prem.premium;

WITH agent_policy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier, pol.Policy_Identifier
  FROM agreement_party_role apr
  JOIN party_role pr ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
  JOIN policy pol ON pol.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
  WHERE lower(pr.Party_Role_Name) = 'agent'
),
prem AS (
  SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium p ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
  FROM claim_coverage cc
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
loss AS (
  SELECT cp.Policy_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_paid
  FROM claim_policy cp
  JOIN claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
  per.First_Name,
  per.Last_Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ap.Policy_Identifier) AS policies_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(prem.total_premium), 0) AS total_premium,
  COALESCE(SUM(loss.total_loss_paid), 0) AS total_loss_paid
FROM agent_policy ap
JOIN person per ON per.Person_Identifier = ap.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem ON prem.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss ON loss.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY per.Person_Identifier, per.First_Name, per.Last_Name;

WITH cost AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_cost
  FROM claim_amount ca
  WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
  )
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  la.Postal_Code,
  SUM(COALESCE(c.total_cost, 0)) AS total_claim_cost,
  AVG(DATEDIFF('day', cl.Claim_Open_Date, cl.Claim_Close_Date)) AS avg_days_open_to_close
FROM claim cl
JOIN insurable_object io ON cl.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN geographic_location gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN location_address la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
LEFT JOIN cost c ON cl.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY la.Postal_Code;

SELECT
  per.First_Name,
  per.Last_Name,
  SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium,
  COUNT(*) AS coverage_periods,
  AVG(pa.Policy_Amount) AS avg_premium_per_coverage_period
FROM person per
JOIN agreement_party_role apr ON apr.Party_Identifier = per.Person_Identifier
JOIN party_role pr ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN policy pol ON pol.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN policy_amount pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
JOIN premium prem ON prem.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%policy%holder%'
GROUP BY per.Person_Identifier, per.First_Name, per.Last_Name;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  p.Policy_Identifier,
  DATE_DIFF('day', a.End_Date, p.Effective_Date) AS days_between,
  per.First_Name,
  per.Last_Name,
  ar.Assessment_Result_Type_Code
FROM policy p
JOIN agreement_assessment aa ON aa.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN assessment a ON a.Assessment_Identifier = aa.Assessment_Identifier
JOIN assessment_result ar ON ar.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
JOIN underwriting_assessment ua ON ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier = ar.Assessment_Result_Identifier
JOIN assesment_party_role apr ON apr.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
JOIN party_role pr ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN person per ON per.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name = 'Underwriter';

WITH paid AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS paid
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
reserved AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS reserved
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN loss_reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
  COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) AS total_loss_paid,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.reserved), 0) AS total_loss_reserved,
  100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(r.reserved), 0), 0) AS paid_share_of_incurred_pct
FROM catastrophe cat
JOIN claim c ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN reserved r ON r.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cat.Catastrophe_Identifier, cat.Catastrophe_Name;

answer.sql:
WITH loss AS (
  SELECT c.Insurable_Object_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
  FROM claim c
  JOIN claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
  )
  GROUP BY c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
prem AS (
  SELECT pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
  FROM policy_amount pa
  WHERE pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Policy_Amount_Identifier FROM premium)
  GROUP BY pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier
)
SELECT
  la.Line_1_Address AS street_address,
  SUM(l.incurred_loss) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(p.total_premium), 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM insurable_object io
JOIN loss l ON l.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN prem p ON p.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN geographic_location gl ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN location_address la ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
GROUP BY la.Line_1_Address
ORDER BY loss_ratio DESC NULLS LAST;
